newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - July 3.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - July 3.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had one large one-day net miss in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The miss occured on Tuesday when lower-than-anticipated Treasury deposits at the Federal Reserve banks resulted in more reserves in the banking system, she said.
The high in natural float was about $2.0 billion on Wednesday, while the low in natural float was about $200 million on Friday.
Transportation float averaged about $70 million per day with the high on Thursday at about $190 million primarily due to ground delays in New York.
